versions.changelog:
- Expanded documentation in SKILL.md to include Description, License, Use case, References, Risks, and Ethical considerations
- Added explicit statement on legal and ethical use in SKILL.md
- No changes to core usage instructions or requirements

Initial release of http-status-explainer.

- Explains HTTP status codes in clear, structured language for API/browser debugging.
- Provides guidance on likely causes, responsible party, and safe next steps for common status codes.
- Handles key headers (e.g. Retry-After, Location, WWW-Authenticate) for tailored advice.
- Summarizes incident-ready messages and clarifies assumptions when details are missing.
- Emphasizes security by not requesting or reflecting secrets.
